proposals.evidence: The full bhāra article explicitly has Lahnda/Punjabi bhārā “heavy” and other a/o-stem heavy adjectives, distinct from the separate bhārika family. These western survey a/o forms retain the complete bhār/bar stem with ordinary masculine vowel endings and variation in aspiration. The link identifies the bhāra adjective family; ī-ending and internally aspirated bhahr- responses are not included.
